Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer repeatedly opened the same pages without extracting new information or verifying Drama Desk Award wins for the cast members. Specifically, WebSurfer did not successfully confirm the Drama Desk Award status for the actresses involved in the 2007 Grease cast album, which is essential to solving the problem. This oversight in extracting award information led to a failure in identifying an actress who meets both criteria (being on the cast album and receiving a Drama Desk Award).
